title: seqera-services/bifrost pipeline parameters
description: Parameters for the Bifrost Nextflow pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the input CSV file containing sample information

meta_mapper.description: Path to the metadata mapper YAML file that defines column mappings

counts.description: Path to the counts CSV file containing probe counts

substances_cell_types.description: Path to YAML file containing test substances and cell types to analyze

batch_mode.description: Way in which to collect probes before passing for analysis. 'all' will collect all probes in one tar file sent to all analysis processes. 'batch' will just group probe files for analysis in the same batch. 'all' will limit the number of files being moved around, but at the cost (without a shared file system) of a large tar.gz being repeatedly copied to individual processes. 'batch' will limit the size of files sent to processes, the cost of potentially large numbers of file operations.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

bifrost_options.title: Bifrost-specific options
bifrost_options.description: Parameters specific to the Bifrost pipeline

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. If not set, results will not be reproducible between runs.

model_file.description: Path to the Stan model file (without .stan extension)

n_cores.description: Number of CPU cores to use for processing

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of nodes to use in Azure Batch (only applicable for Azure profile)

batch_key.description: Field to use as batch key in the BIFROST model

min_percent_mapped_reads.description: Minimum percentage of mapped reads required

min_num_mapped_reads.description: Minimum number of mapped reads required

test_probes.description: Number of probes to sample for testing (optional)

precompile_model.description: Whether to pre-compile the Nextflow script before execution
precompile_model.help_text: Set to 'true' on shared file systems to compile the model once and share it across instances. Set to 'false' when no shared file system is available, requiring each instance to compile separately. On shared systems, not enabling this forces 'stageInMode' to prevent simultaneous model compilation.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

report_options.title: Report options
report_options.description: Parameters for customizing the MultiQC report generation

report_interactive_plots.description: Force interactive plots (may be faster for large datasets)

report_n_fold_change_probes.description: Number of most up/down regulated probes to show

report_cds_threshold.description: Concentration-Dependency Score threshold for filtering probes

report_n_lowest_means.description: Number of lowest mean PoD probes to show

report_n_pod_stats.description: Number of probes to include in PoD statistics table

report_control_line_tolerance.description: Tolerance for filtering similar control lines

report_min_control_lines.description: Minimum number of control lines to show

report_plot_height.description: Height of concentration-response plots in pixels

report_pod_vs_fc_height.description: Height of PoD vs Fold Change plot in pixels

report_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for report generation

report_plots_force_flat_numseries.description: Maximum number of series for flat plots
